headline: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure on substantial acquisition of shares.
sum: Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited has filed a mandatory Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE marking a substantial acquisition of shares or voting rights in the company; specific acquirer identity and stake percentage not yet confirmed from available public sources.
detail: A substantial acquisition of shares in Madhya Bharat Agro Products Limited has triggered the mandatory disclosure requirement under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4). The disclosure has been filed with NSE and archived in the regulator's official repository. The acquirer is required to make an open offer to public shareholders unless a specific exemption applies (e.g., creeping acquisition under Reg 31A, or FIPB/government approval for strategic sale). Completion of the open offer and delisting (if applicable) would follow.
